nodes.name: Approved feed webhook
nodes.notes: Attach a dedicated partner-ingress Header Auth credential after import. Do not reuse the LeadForge CRON or per-source ingestion credential.

nodes.name: LeadForge source-token ingestion
nodes.notes: Before activation set the LeadForge URL and attach the separate n8n Header Auth credential containing the one-time bearer token for exactly one approved, active LeadForge source. Ingestion is idempotent/deduplicated by LeadForge; confirm source host and data-use authorization first.

requires: Dedicated partner-ingress Header Auth credential in n8n
Dedicated LeadForge per-source ingestion bearer credential in n8n
A matching approved and active LeadForge feed source with source_url host restrictions
meta.safety: Accepts public listing summaries only; never accepts owner contact/private property details. No website crawling is performed. Workflow is intentionally inactive.
